description: 90 Most Likely To party questions — draw, shuffle, and vote on who fits each one.

faqs.a: 90 lighthearted questions like 'Most likely to survive on a desert island?' — vote by pointing at the person who fits.
Draw deals the next question without repeating; Shuffle resets the whole deck.
The counter shows how many questions remain in the current deck.

howto: Everyone points at who is most likely.
Press Shuffle Deck for a fresh order anytime.
title: Most Likely To Questions
